title: Zero-tape parity decision
statement: There exists a finite Turing machine with no work tapes that, on every Boolean word $x$, halts within $|x|+1$ steps and outputs $1$ exactly when the number of entries of $x$ equal to $1$ is even, and outputs $0$ otherwise.
